name: PlatformIndicators
description: Adds platform indicators (Desktop, Mobile, Web...) to users
summary: Desktop, mobile and web indicators next to users

settings.label: Member list
settings.description: Show indicators in the member list

settings.label: Color mobile indicator
settings.description: Whether to make the mobile indicator match the color of the user status.

settings.label: Show bots
settings.description: Whether to show platform indicators on bots

notes: Icons follow the platforms in a user's presence (client_status) and, for yourself, your sessions, coloured with the theme's status colours. Qord reads client_status as a JSON object, which sorts the platforms alphabetically, where Discord keeps the order it received. Color mobile indicator shows the phone-shaped status dot for mobile users whatever their status (upstream's isMobileOnline patches); it needs modify_displayed_messages.
